subject: [PATCH v4 11/21] zonefs: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch converts the iomap operations in the zonefs filesystem to use the new ->iomap_next() callback. This is done by generating each callback using the DEFINE_IOMAP_ITER_NEXT() macro, which wraps the iomap_iter_next() helper to finish previous mappings and produce next ones. The change does not introduce any functional changes.
